resetDescription:
This will:

- Remove added file sources and locally saved authorization credentials
- Restore language, appearance, hints, and default cloud locations
- Clear the current rule chain

It will not delete real files or undo completed renames.
readFailed: Could not load app settings. Using default settings for now. Check your network connection and refresh the page to try again.
languageSaveFailed: Could not save the language. The interface has returned to the previous settings: {{message}}
themeSaveFailed: Could not save the appearance. The interface has returned to the previous settings: {{message}}
resetBusy: A preview is being generated or names are being changed. Wait for it to finish before resetting.
resetSaving: Other operations are in progress. Try again shortly.
resetOutcomeUnknown: The reset result was not received. Refresh the page and check whether file sources and settings have been reset.
saveOutcomeUnknown: The save result was not received. The interface has temporarily returned to the previous settings. Refresh the page to verify.
readFailedCached: Could not load the latest app settings. Using the current settings for now.
